[[File:Albert Tavkhelidze 1986.jpg|thumb|Albert Tavkhelidze in 1986]]
'''Albert Nikiforovich Tavkhelidze''' ({{langx|ru|Альберт Никифорович Тавхелидзе}}, {{lang-ka|ალბერტ ნიკიფორეს ძე თავხელიძე}}; 16 December 1930 {{endash}} 27 February 2010) was President of the [[Georgian National Academy of Sciences]] (1986{{endash}}2005).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://science.gov.az/forms/pokoynyie-poch%D1%91tnyie-chlenyi/165 |title=Tavxelidze Albert Nikiforoviç (1930–2010) |author= |date=2017 |publisher=science.gov.az |accessdate=2017-03-20 |language=az }}</ref><ref>{{Citation | periodical=Physics-Uspekhi | surname1=Amaglobeli | title=Albert Nikiforovich Tavkhelidze (on his seventieth birthday) | volume=44 | date=2001 | language=German | pages=207–208 | doi=10.1070/pu2001v044n02abeh000938 | first1=N. S. | last2=Baldin | first2=A. M. | last3=Zatsepin | first3=G. T. | last4=Kadyshevskii | first4= V G, Lobashev V M, Krasnikov N V, Matveev V A, Rubakov V A, Sissakian A N, Slavnov A A, Chudakov A E, Shirkov D V| issue=2 | s2cid=250784923 }}</ref> Tavkhelidze was a Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, Professor, Academician of the Georgian National Academy of Sciences; and earned a Fellowship in the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web
 | url =http://science.org.ge/old/cv/tavkhelidze-eng.html
